posts.author: reebunny
posts.body:
So I'm making a game that has the mechanics of street fighter for combat, and was originally working with MV but it's become just too old for me to use good plug-ins with for more features and considering moving up to MZ.
Is there a plugin that gives you street fighter mechanics in MZ like LMBS?

posts.author: ZimXero
posts.body:
It might work with Dragonbones plugin.  Approximately (my guess) 40% of MV plugins work flawlessly with it assisting in the background.  Another 30% or so work, but can encounter bugs/glitches depending on their exact usage and plugin orders.  The remaining 30% just wont work in MZ.  There is a list of ones that work well but it is certainly not complete.
https://sidemv.itch.io/sidemv-sidescroller
is the only similar plugin I can see for MV, none for MZ.
You could check out....
https://beregon.itch.io/luke-daimont-absolute-mayhem
It is a sidescroll game made for an MZ event.  It has some commentary explaining how it was made.
Also, you might be interested in ATT_Turan's
POST
on plugins to assist side-scroll MZ game making:
